verdict.rationale: Fellow automatically produces suggested AI action items for every meeting. Action items carry assignees and due dates and can be listed, filtered by owner scope, and marked complete or archived, which gives a trackable collection. However, no evidence shows the AI automatically assigns owners from the conversation, and the items are only 'suggested', so the automatic owner part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: evidence that owners are auto-assigned from the conversation, confirmation that suggested items become tracked without manual acceptance, independent/hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
